ladder.label: Eumetazoa
ladder.blurb: An animal invention. Present in flies and worms, absent in yeast.

ladder.label: Vertebrata

ladder.label: Mammalia
ladder.blurb: A mammalian innovation, or at least a mammalian-specific version.
